name: movies-list
description: A JWT-authenticated movie collection: Express + TypeScript + MongoDB API and a Create React App + Tailwind client.

scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix movies-list-web start" "npm --prefix movies-list-api run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix movies-list-api run build && npm --prefix movies-list-web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix movies-list-api test && npm --prefix movies-list-web test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix movies-list-api run typecheck && npm --prefix movies-list-web run typecheck
